youtube.title: Padlock ke neeche chhota sa hole kyun hota hai? 🔒 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Padlock ko ulta karke dekho, neeche ek chhota sa hole milega. Ye doosri chaabi ke liye nahi hai. Padlock bahar barish mein rehte hain, aur shackle ke aas-paas se paani andar chala jaata hai, jiske nikalne ka koi raasta nahi hota.

Andar fansa paani springs ko zang laga deta hai, ya jamkar lock ko jam kar deta hai. Ye hole paani ko bahar nikaal deta hai. Hidden Why roz ek nayi wajah batata hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
